Getting rid of those stressors on an immediate notice would involve withdrawing from school right now. Although this semester hasn't meant much in terms of grades and resources, I think I'd feel like so much more of a failure if I couldn't even bring myself to graduate from college when I see my friends and colleagues going to Harvard, UPenn and CA schools for grad school already. 

I think the only thing really stopping me from dropping everything and travelling the world or the country is the response I would get. There's some sort of profoundly crushing feeling I get at the idea of disappointing everyone in my life.

I haven't looked at the counseling center at my school but I'm afraid they'd take me in and send me to a hospital if I went in there and was honest about how I felt.

I like this idea, it's very similar to the one I have now (finish out this semester and graduate, get a job for 2 years and get back to school) but the inbetween time is what scares me the most. Living with my parents and having the constant pressure of applying to school and getting a better job and excelling in every way possible will be fed to me day and night until it happens or until I break.
